rule: reject every existing output, archive, temporary file or report directory before spawning; retain rejection and partial child receipts; never remove a destination automatically
clock: parent perf_counter around preflight and the complete unchanged child command, including child startup and final writes; measurement receipt is administrative IO after the measured child
admission: validate complete command receipts before proof, profile, admission, study and audit; frozen admission binds the measured own/native receipt bytes
native_timing_guard: strict twice complete command elapsed below900, in addition to the frozen inner guard
preservation: all earlier source and complete/partial/failing data remain unchanged; full new-source checks and proof/forecast gates required; no scientific seed/grid/cap/tolerance/default changes
